description: Search the Ukraine Open Data portal catalogue by keyword in Ukrainian or English. Matches words (and their endings) in dataset titles, tags, publishing organisation and the start of the description; every word must match. Returns each dataset's id and name, title, publishing organisation, tags, file formats, resource count, licence and last-modified date, newest first. Use data_ua_dataset for the resource list. Blank query lists the newest datasets. Answered from a stored copy of the catalogue metadata; every answer carries its data date.

query.description: Keyword(s), e.g. "бюджет" or "air quality"; blank/"*" lists the newest datasets.

name: data_ua_search_datasets
title: Data Ua Search Datasets
